id: MOTLD: own arm motion alone and with a varying hand load, with and without a push - final controller (OURS) vs stepping baseline (B11) vs our controller with the centroidal+IMU estimate (CI)
registered: 2026-11-11, before any MOTLD run. Fall criterion: CRITERIA_FC.json (non-foot ground contact, pelvis height < 0.5 m, tilt stop 1.0 rad; recovered = no fall and standing at the end). Runs use permissive stops (tilt 1.2 rad, height 0.4 m) and are scored by fc_rescore.score. Amended 2026-11-11 03:35 before any run: D3 restricted to the M cells (a hand load is a real external wrench, not a spurious estimate); steps contact-counted (contact_steps.count, as MOTCI); spurious estimate defined as in MOTCI (max horizontal |d6 - mean d6 over 1.0-1.9 s| for 2.0-6.0 s).

arms.CI: OURS with the centroidal+IMU estimate (RA_EST_ALT=cimu, as MOTCI CI)

cells.M: ACCAD lift / swing / gesture / jab from 2 s, no load, no push
cells.L: the same motions with a varying right-hand load 2 kg from 1 s, 0 kg at 4 s, 1 kg at 5.5 s (pick, place, re-grasp; --mass-schedule 1:2,4:0,5.5:1), no push
cells.Lx: as L with a 0.2 s x+50 N push at 3 s
cells.Ly: as L with a 0.2 s y-50 N push at 3 s

seeds: 1390-1395 (new); 4 motions x 4 cells x 6 seeds x 3 arms = 288 runs, 10 s each
metrics: recovered, held in place (recovered without a contact-counted step), contact-counted steps (contact_steps.count, from 2.9 s, until the fall), hold entries after 2 s (OURS, CI), peak spurious estimate as in MOTCI (M cells, OURS, CI)

predictions.D1 no push (M and L, 48 pairs): OURS vs B11: recovered OURS >= B11 - 2 and steps OURS <= B11
predictions.D2 push (Lx and Ly, 48 pairs, primary): OURS vs B11: held in place OURS > B11, exact McNemar p < .05, and recovered OURS >= B11 - 2
predictions.R1 push, OURS vs CI (reported, two-sided: held, recovered and steps with exact McNemar p
predictions.D3 motion only (M, 24 pairs): OURS vs CI: peak spurious estimate lower for OURS, Wilcoxon signed-rank p < .01

analysis: motld_analyze.py, written before the runs; per-motion tallies reported
